title: Expose Admin single-lesson operations in the center dashboard
verify: A disposable protected Admin browser/HTTP flow reaches the actual dashboard, renders server-resolved lessons, and completes add, transfer, and cancel for one selected lesson while leaving sibling repetitions unchanged.

Independent /verify must return PASS and the required T3 per-task /red-verify must return semantic-pass; source review must show owner-boundary calls, server-generated add identity, and no route/component persistence or authorization bypass.

Independent /verify attempt 1: VERDICT: PASS. Verifier-owned disposable probe `.tasks/TASK-104-T3-FT-002-W20/verify-attempt-1.md` proves SSR lesson projection, add/transfer/cancel behavior, server-generated lessonId, class/schedule selector consistency, non-Admin denial, completed-cancel rejection, and full Schedule/Lesson state equality; repeated check/build/test/diff gates passed. Next required step: `/red-verify TASK-104-T3-FT-002-W20`.

evidence: Fresh disposable real-browser/HTTP probe passed 1/1 on Desktop Chrome: the protected Admin dashboard rendered server-resolved lessons and completed add, transfer, and cancel while preserving sibling rows.

The probe preserved transfer lessonId, authored context, attendance, and charge identity; ignored an injected browser lessonId for add; and denied unauthenticated, non-Admin, cross-center, forged, mismatched, invalid-date, and completed-cancel requests with complete snapshot equality.

Current npm run check, npm run build, npm run test (69 files / 240 tests), and git diff --check all passed; route/component source contains no direct persistence or client-owned authorization. Prior executor and semantic artifacts remain supporting evidence; lifecycle was not changed.

purpose: Complete the accepted REQ-004 browser path by exposing the existing Center & Scheduling single-lesson commands through the protected own-center Admin dashboard.
success_outcome: An authenticated own-center Admin can see the server-resolved lessons for a class and add one lesson, transfer one planned lesson, or cancel one eligible lesson from the browser; transfer preserves lesson identity and unrelated lessons, add identity is generated server-side, and denied or invalid requests do not mutate scheduling state.
anti_goals: Do not change the existing Center & Scheduling owner semantics or recurring schedule replacement rules.
Do not add a Teacher schedule HTTP transport, Lesson Context/calendar content, or financial write behavior.
Do not trust client-supplied role, center, class, schedule, or lesson authority and do not write scheduling tables from routes or components.
Do not change completed TASK-006 or TASK-026 records, dependencies, evidence, or lifecycle.

stop_conditions: Stop and route to /spec-redesign if the Admin path requires a new ownership edge, a new persistence owner, or a public contract beyond the accepted Center & Scheduling boundary.
Stop if implementing the browser controls requires changing Teacher transport, Lesson Context/calendar behavior, financial state, recurring schedule semantics, or the existing authorization model.
Stop if a route or component would need direct database access or client-owned role, center, class, schedule, or lesson authorization.

constraints: The Admin route resolves the existing server actor and own-center class/lesson projection before every mutation; hidden client fields are selectors, not authority.
Center & Scheduling remains the sole writer of Schedule and Lesson state; routes and components only adapt Form Data and owner results.

The add action generates a fresh lesson identity server-side and supplies a canonical ISO lesson date to the owner command; transfer and cancel target only server-resolved lessons for the selected class.
Preserve the existing recurring schedule, zero-occurrence, transfer identity, and charge-identity semantics and keep the existing safe dashboard error envelope.
invariants: Only the selected lesson changes during transfer or cancellation; unrelated recurring lessons retain identity, date, and status.
A transferred lesson keeps its `lessonId`, scheduling-owned context, and existing chargeable identity; adding a lesson does not duplicate another lesson identity.
Completed lessons remain protected from cancellation and invalid or out-of-scope requests leave Schedule/Lesson state unchanged.
The browser surface never chooses or changes actor role, center membership, class scope, or ownership.
verification_targets: FT-002-AC-003 / REQ-004: disposable real protected Admin browser/HTTP flow renders the server-resolved lesson projection and proves add, transfer, and cancel for one selected lesson with unaffected sibling repetitions.
FT-002-AC-004 / REQ-004: transfer identity/context and disposable chargeable-lesson identity remain stable, with no duplicate lesson or chargeable row created by the browser path.

FT-002-AC-003 / REQ-004: the same disposable flow proves every submitted `classId`/`scheduleId` pair is matched against the server projection, mismatched selectors are rejected before mutation with full state equality, and the add adapter creates a fresh server-generated `lessonId` rather than accepting a browser-selected identity.
FT-002-AC-003 / REQ-004: a completed lesson cancellation is rejected before persistence and the full Schedule/Lesson state snapshot is unchanged, including completed status and timestamps.

REQ-014: unauthenticated, non-Admin, cross-center, forged-class, forged-lesson, completed-cancel, and invalid-date requests fail at the server boundary and preserve a complete Schedule/Lesson state snapshot.

Boundary/source proof: `src/routes/admin/center-dashboard.server.ts` and `src/routes/admin/[centerId]/+page.svelte` contain no direct persistence or client-owned authorization, and the owner calls remain on the registered Calendar and Membership Query Boundary.
Project gates: `npm run check`, `npm run build`, `npm run test`, and `git diff --check`; independent `/verify` PASS and required T3 per-task `/red-verify` semantic-pass.
